text_block_list.text:
It's the day of Фудзи Кисэки's debut.
Despite being a
newcomer, everyone is
expecting such great
things from her
that even I get put into the
spotlight as
her trainer.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
To calm my nerves, she uses magic to
conjure a
piece of chocolate for me. Her
magic effective,
she gallantly heads off
to her race.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
